usedFor: AltTextify writes alt text for images, and “Generate Image Alt Text” creates it from an image URL.

bestTemplate.name: “Generate Image Alt Text” in AltTextify
bestTemplate.why: It turns an image URL into descriptive alt text, which helps accessibility and search on your site.

watchOut: “Generate Image Alt Text” in AltTextify needs an image URL, so the step before it must pass one.
